what: Proposals for review. None is implemented: the brief requires a path to be chosen before implementation, so each carries options, a recommendation and its cost/risk.

suggestions.title: Capture closing lines from a licensed feed
suggestions.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — awaiting a chosen path
suggestions.problem: No price exists in the repository, so no edge can be measured and the parlay pricing requirement cannot be met.

options.label: License a feed and add a capture step
options.risk: the feed's terms may forbid republication

options.label: Publish model numbers with no market comparison, permanently
options.risk: the 'edge' framing of the brief goes unmet

options.label: Record lines manually per slate with a timestamp
options.risk: manual entry is the failure mode this project avoids

suggestions.recommended: A, but only with a feed whose terms permit republication; otherwise B with the gap stated (which is what is published today).

suggestions.title: Extend the game-log capture to a rolling season window
suggestions.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — awaiting a chosen path
suggestions.problem: Minutes redistribution, player props and prop correlations all need per-player history. Today there is one slate (99 rows), which makes the share model a demonstration rather than a forecast.

options.label: Capture the season to date from gamebook PDFs
options.risk: the parser rejects ~7% of rows; rejections must keep being published

options.label: Capture only players appearing on an injury report
options.risk: props for anyone else stay blank

suggestions.recommended: B first: it satisfies the brief's stated minimum and keeps the rejection rate auditable, then A if props become a priority.

suggestions.title: Add a postponement/abandonment rule to every pre-registration
suggestions.problem: Settlement is defined only for a game that finishes.

options.label: Void the pick (no win, no loss)
options.risk: voids can be gamed by publishing picks on fragile games

options.label: Leave unsettled and report it as pending
options.risk: the ledger never closes for that game

suggestions.recommended: B, because it records reality rather than assigning an outcome. It must be written into the files before the next slate, not after an event.

suggestions.title: Populate the arena coordinate table from a citable source
suggestions.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — awaiting a chosen path
suggestions.problem: Travel distance is blank for all 44 team-games.

options.label: Source an official venue list with coordinates
options.risk: the NBA may not publish coordinates at all

options.label: Drop travel and say so
options.risk: part of the brief goes unmet

suggestions.recommended: A if a citable table exists; otherwise B, with the omission on the Flagged page.

suggestions.title: Turn the disagreement signal into a scored feature
suggestions.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — awaiting a chosen path
suggestions.problem: Disagreement is the published headline but has not been shown to predict error. That is a testable claim and it is currently untested.

options.label: Bin games by disagreement and measure log-loss per bin
options.risk: 128 OOS games split into bins is thin

suggestions.recommended: A with the bin counts published, so a thin result reads as thin rather than as a finding.

suggestions.title: Anchor the ledger head hash outside the repository
suggestions.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — awaiting a chosen path
suggestions.problem: The chain is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: a full rewrite rebuilds the chain. The git commit is a weak witness.

options.label: Publish the head hash to an external timestamping service
Keep the git commit as the witness and say so
options.risk: a reader may assume more than it proves

suggestions.recommended: B now (it is stated on the Ledger page), A if the ledger ever carries real money.

suggestions.title: Resolve the 13 unattributed injury rows
suggestions.problem: 13 player rows per report cannot be tied to a club from the PDF text layout.

options.label: Improve the extraction to read the team block reliably
options.risk: a plausible-looking wrong attribution is worse than a blank

options.label: Drop them and publish the count

suggestions.recommended: A, with B as the fallback if attribution cannot be made mechanical.
